title: Dashboard cards that show a table list their rows as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Needs no test data of its own.

Setup

  1. Check the setup worked: the Dashboard opens (see step 1) and shows cards.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu (on this build: click the ShopView logo at the top left; it opens /dashboard).
  2. Find each card that shows a table (e.g. At Risk Customers; also Efficiency by Tech, Billing Efficiency by Advisor, Effective Labor Rate (ELR) by Advisor, Utilization by Tech).
  3. Read its rows and, where offered, click a column header to sort.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each table card shows its rows with no error message, and a clicked header orders the rows. Write down the cards you checked.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Low; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §Frontend Components; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
